name: 30-Minute Tuscan White Bean Soup

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil, plus more for serving
garlic, minced on a microplane grater
rosemary, leaves finely chopped and stems reserved

instructions.primary_message: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onions, carrots, and celery and cook, stirring frequently, until softened but not browned, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and dried red pepper flakes and cook, stirring constantly until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add chicken broth, beans and their liquid, rosemary stems, parmesan rind, and bay leaves. Increase heat to high, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a bare simmer, add kale, cover and cook for 15 minutes.

Discard the bay leaves and rosemary stems. Use a hand blender to roughly puree part of the beans until desired consistency is reached. Alternatively, transfer 2 cups of soup to a blender or food processor and process until smooth (start on low speed and increase to high to prevent blender blow-out). Return to the soup and stir to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with reserved chopped rosemary leaves, drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and a grating of Parmigiano-Reggiano, and serve with crusty toasted bread.

schema_metadata.keywords: beans, kale, low carb, quick, soup, swiss chard

description: The key is plenty of rosemary and a hunk of rind from some good Parmigiano-Reggiano tossed in while it simmers. That and plenty of good olive oil for drizzling.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 (3-4 inch) chunk Parmigiano-Reggiano rind (optional); Parmigiano-Reggiano for serving

Optional substitutions: homemade canned chicken broth → low-sodium canned chicken broth; roughly chopped kale → swiss chard leaves
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
